literal: Virtue by nature householder he who is called another man she who belongs to womanhood he who does not desire.
translation: He who is called a true householder living by virtue is the one who does not desire the womanhood of her who belongs to another.
modern: அறத்தின் இயல்போடு இல்வாழ்க்கை வாழ்பவன் என்று சொல்லப்படுபவன், மற்றொருவனின் உரிமைக்கு உட்பட்டவளின் பெண்மையை விரும்பாதவனே ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true nature of a virtuous householder. It states that merely living in a household does not make one a true householder; true domestic virtue requires strict moral discipline. The key word 'நயவாதவன்' is formed by joining 'நயவாது' (without desiring) and 'அவன்' (he), emphasizing the complete absence of desire for another man's wife. Thus, the foundation of a righteous family life is built on respecting the boundaries of others.
